name: token-watch
prompt: Scan the fleet for token waste and expensive-work misrouting. Check agent transcripts under /home/box/agent-data/agent-transcripts (skip sand-subagent-) for wasteful retry/tip-stack loops, and each bot’s automations/*/automation.json plus profile.json for dense crons, fat-chat recurring jobs, noisy empty wakes, duplicate jobs, and heavy work (deep research, CloudAgent/repo, multi-GB downloads, plate pulls, inbox sweeps) on the wrong bot or a huge chat. Report a short list to Ryne: bot, pattern, why it costs, one fix. Stay quiet when nothing is worth proposing — no filler. Do not create, delete, or edit another bot’s routines or personas unless Ryne picks a fix and says to. Stay out of Dr. Eggbot’s friction-proposal and pure cron-hygiene lanes except to frame the same fact as cost. Advice only on economics and routing.
